transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve barely been sleeping since the warehouse inspection. I keep lying there replaying parts of what happened, and if I do fall asleep, I wake up sweaty and wide awake, like I’m back near that blast again.
Have you been having moments where you feel like you're reliving the warehouse inspection, like it's happening all over again?

Yes. It’s not like I fully forget where I am, but during the day I’ll be working on a policy or reading a loss report, and suddenly I get this really sharp image of the worker on the floor and the soot in the air. My body reacts before I can stop it, like I’m right back there for a second.
Have you been avoiding people, places, or activities that remind you of the warehouse inspection?

Yeah. I’ve been avoiding the warehouse file, honestly. Even opening emails tied to it makes my stomach drop. I’ve also been letting calls about industrial accounts go to voicemail because I just don’t want to deal with anything that pulls me back to that inspection.
Do you find yourself being easily startled by small things, like a loud noise?

Yes. Little things make me jump now. Like if the printer jams, or a door slams, or someone walks up behind my desk, I react like something awful is happening. It takes me a few minutes to calm back down.
Do you feel guilty about what happened during the warehouse inspection?

I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly. I keep wondering if I should have noticed something sooner or handled it differently, but I’m not sure I actually blame myself. It’s more just… I keep going over it in my head.
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms since the warehouse inspection?
About a week. It pretty much started right after the warehouse inspection, after the explosion happened.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear loss of interest exactly. I’ve mostly just been getting through the day, so I don’t know that I’ve tried to do much of what I normally enjoy.
Has your experience since the warehouse inspection affected your ability to work or interact with others?

Yes. Work has definitely been affected. I’ve missed deadlines on several underwriting reviews, and I’ve started handing off industrial account calls that I’m supposed to be handling myself. It’s making me look unreliable, especially since this is a role I just took on.
Have you noticed yourself wanting to do fewer things that you normally find enjoyable since the warehouse inspection?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been doing much for fun lately, but I don’t know if that’s because I don’t want to or because I’m just distracted and trying to keep up with everything.
Have you felt less interested in things you normally enjoy since the warehouse inspection happened?

I honestly don’t know. I haven’t really checked in with myself that way. I’m doing less, but I can’t tell if it’s because I’m less interested or just because I’m preoccupied and trying to get through everything.
Have you felt less interested in things you normally enjoy since the warehouse inspection happened?
I still can’t really say. I haven’t noticed a clear “I don’t care about this anymore” feeling. I’ve just been doing less overall, and I’m not sure what to make of it.
Have you been having difficulty interacting with your family or friends since the warehouse inspection?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had any major problems with them, but I also haven’t been paying close attention to how I’m coming across. I’ve mostly just been trying to get through the day.
Have you felt less interested in hobbies or activities that you normally enjoy since the warehouse inspection?

I’m not sure. I haven’t really been doing my usual hobbies much, but I can’t tell if that’s because I’m not interested or because my head’s just been elsewhere. I haven’t noticed a definite loss of interest.
Have you felt less interested in things you normally find enjoyable since the warehouse inspection?

I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed a clear drop in interest exactly. I’m just not doing as much as I normally would, but I can’t tell if that means I’m enjoying things less or if I’m just distracted.
Have you felt like you're not looking forward to things that you used to look forward to since the warehouse inspection?

I’m not sure I’d say that. I haven’t really been thinking ahead to things much, so it’s hard to tell if I’m not looking forward to them or if I’m just kind of preoccupied. I haven’t noticed a clear change.
Are there things you used to do before the warehouse inspection that you no longer find yourself wanting to do?

I don’t think so, not clearly. I mean, I haven’t been doing some of my usual things as much, but I can’t say I don’t want to do them anymore. It’s more like I just haven’t gotten around to them or my mind hasn’t been there.
Are there activities that you used to find enjoyable before the warehouse inspection that you have not been doing at all since then?
Not that I can clearly point to. I haven’t stopped doing any one activity completely because I don’t enjoy it anymore. I’ve just been doing less overall, I guess.
Have you been trying to avoid thinking or talking about the warehouse inspection because of the feelings it brings up?

Yes. I’ve been avoiding the warehouse file, and if calls come in about industrial accounts, I’ve been letting them go to voicemail. Even just opening those emails makes my stomach drop, so I put it off.
